data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: The manifest blocks applier execution until a reviewer attestation file is present in bridge_state/bootstrap/orphans-<pass>.attested.json

## Given / When / Then
Given a manifest at bridge_state/bootstrap/orphans-P.manifest.json; When gate --pass P is invoked under four scenarios — (a) no attestation file, (b) attestation exists but commit unsigned, (c) attestation signed by bot email in allowlist, (d) attestation signed by non-bot human committer; Then scenarios (a)-(c) exit non-zero with their respective stderr diagnostics AND scenario (d) exits 0.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] gate exits non-zero with 'attestation missing' when attested.json is absent
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_gate.py::test_gate_blocks_when_attestation_missing
- [ ] gate exits non-zero with 'attestation signature invalid' when git verify-commit fails
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_gate.py::test_gate_blocks_when_signature_invalid
- [ ] gate exits non-zero with 'attestation committer is a bot' when committer email matches bot allowlist
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_gate.py::test_gate_blocks_when_committer_is_bot
- [ ] gate exits 0 only when attestation exists, git verify-commit succeeds, and committer is non-bot human
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_gate.py::test_gate_passes_for_signed_human_attestation

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/orphan_band.py (Edit)
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_orphan_band_gate.py (Create)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED: Implement orphan-band gate subcommand verifying signed reviewer attestation
